aarti.tek: Om, victory to you, Kubera, lord of the yakṣas, O Lord; Master, victory, victory to you, Kubera, lord of the yakṣas, O Lord. Kubera fills the storehouses of the devotees who have come to his refuge.
aarti.pad1: Among the devotees of Śiva, Kubera is a great devotee; Master, Kubera is a great devotee. He fought a great many battles with daityas, dānavas and men. ॥1॥
aarti.pad2: He is seated on a golden throne, and a canopy turns above his head; Master, a canopy turns above his head. The yoginīs sing songs of blessing, and all raise the cry of victory. ॥2॥
aarti.pad3: In his hands are a mace and a trident; he bears many weapons; Master, he bears many weapons. He who frees from sorrow, fear and trouble twangs his bow. ॥3॥
aarti.pad4: Dishes of every kind are prepared in plenty; Master, dishes are prepared in plenty. The devotees offer the sweet mohanbhog, and with it black gram and chickpeas. ॥4॥
aarti.pad5: You are the giver of strength, wisdom and knowledge; we have fallen at your refuge; Master, we have fallen at your refuge. You set right all the works of your devotees. ॥5॥
aarti.pad6: A jewel shines in your crown, and a necklace of pearls is at your throat; Master, a necklace of pearls is at your throat. There is a wick of agarwood and camphor, and a flame of ghee burns. ॥6॥
aarti.pad7: Whoever sings the āratī of Kubera, lord of the yakṣas — Master, whoever sings it — says Premapāla Svāmī, gains the fruit his heart desires. ॥7॥
